name: zgeometry_clip_polygon_create_from_point_list
description: zGeometry_ClipPolygon::CreateFromPointList allocates a clip polygon, copies the input points, rotates them into XY clipping space, records the point count, and computes XY bounds.
known_limits: Binary Ninja renders the inlined rep movsd/movsb point copy as split memcpy-like operations. tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry model/clip-patch source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46aa40 validates allocation and zeroing of a 0x1c clip polygon, allocation of pointCount * sizeof(zVec3) bytes, copying the input point list, RotatePos90AroundX, storing pointCount, ComputeBoundsXY, and returning the allocated clip polygon.
The native clip-polygon smoke verifies input points are copied to distinct storage, rotated into clipping XY space, point count is stored, and XY bounds match the rotated points.
